pages.text: $(item)Handsaws$() (stone to netherite) stay in the grid and lose 1 durability. Any saw is needed for the $(item)Sawmill$().

$(item)Wire Cutters$() (steel) work the same way: ingot + wire cutters = $(item)Fine Copper/Iron Wire$(). Four fine copper wires around an iron ingot make a $(item)Copper Coil$().$(br2)The $(item)Screwdriver$() rotates gates, machines and vanilla blocks; Shift rotates the other way. Shift-right-click a gate to pick it up with its settings. It never wears out.
